FILES: rich/highlighter.py:101
ROOT CAUSE: The `url` regex pattern in `ReprHighlighter` does not include the `@` character, which breaks highlighting for URLs containing authentication information (e.g., `https://user:pass@host.com`).
CHANGE: Add `@` to the character class in the `url` regex pattern: `r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"` becomes `r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~@]*)"`.
TEST: tests/test_highlighter.py

I have fixed the bug where the `@` character broke highlighting in hyperlinks by adding it to the `url` regex pattern in `ReprHighlighter` within `rich/highlighter.py`.

Changed:
`rich/highlighter.py`: Updated the `url` regex pattern to include `@`.

To verify the fix, you can run the tests in `tests/test_highlighter.py`.

arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/repro.py <<'EOF'
from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text

highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
url = "https://user:pass@host.com/path"
text = Text(f"'{url}'")
highlighted = highlighter.highlight(text)

# The URL part should be highlighted. 
# In ReprHighlighter, URLs are typically highlighted with a specific style.
# We check if the URL part of the string is tagged.
# The string is "'https://user:pass@host.com/path'"
# The quotes are usually not part of the URL match in ReprHighlighter's regex
# because it's looking for the protocol start.

# Let's see what the highlighter does.
# We expect the URL to be highlighted.
# If the @ broke it, the match would stop at @.

# We can check the spans of the highlighted text.
# The URL starts at index 1 (after the quote).
# If it works, the span should cover the whole URL.

# Since we don't know the exact style name, we just check if there's a span 
# that covers the @ character.

found_url_span = False
for span in highlighted.spans:
    # span is (start, end, style)
    if span[0] == 1 and span[1] == len(url) + 1:
        found_url_span = True
        break

assert found_url_span, f"URL with @ was not highlighted as a single unit. Spans: {highlighted.spans}"
EOF
python3 /tmp/repro.py; echo EXIT=$?
